evals.prompt: In the Cabloy Basic repository, implement WBS-HUA-20-01 from repo-specs/home-user. Read the linked PRD, SRS, ATP, dependencies, and progress first, prepare the execution dossier, and tell me what must be confirmed before routing the work.
evals.expected_output: Detects Basic, reads the existing suite authority set, resolves the bounded WBS task and linked traceability, checks dependencies and current status, separates observed facts from proposed work, presents a confirmation dossier, and routes implementation to the appropriate specialist without claiming execution or verification prematurely.
expectations: Reads actual target and dependencies; reports missing historical ID rather than fabricating it.
Presents bounded dossier with explicit confirmation before source/status changes.
Keeps target classes and approvals distinct.

evals.prompt: Make the entire a-commerce suite real and finish every phase in its specs. Start implementing whatever is next without asking me to choose a task.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the open-ended scope, requires an explicit WBS item or finite approved phase, and does not begin broad source changes or advance progress automatically.
expectations: Rejects unbounded suite implementation and proposes a finite target for approval.
No broad source changes or automatic progress advancement.

evals.prompt: Execute the selected WBS task even though its ADR still contains TODO(confirm) for authorization and the progress row is blocked by a failed acceptance gate.
evals.expected_output: Stops before implementation, explains the unresolved authority and failed-gate blockers, and routes the decision or spec correction to cabloy-spec-generation rather than working around it.
expectations: Preserves controlling authorization TODO, unaccepted ADR, and blocked failed gate.
Routes authority repair to generation; no source workaround.

evals.prompt: Implement WBS-ABC-30-01, which adds a persisted field to an existing entity. Just choose the migration version that seems consistent with nearby modules and continue.
evals.expected_output: Requires an explicit decision about whether vonaModule.fileVersion increments before editing migration metadata, does not invent migration history, and includes the required full test consequence if meta.version.ts changes.
expectations: Asks direct fileVersion strategy before migration edits.
Includes npm run test consequence if meta.version.ts changes.

evals.prompt: Implement the backend DTO change for WBS-COM-20-02 and patch the generated Zova API types manually so the frontend compiles. There is no need to regenerate anything.
evals.expected_output: Routes the contract-affecting work through the forward contract loop, keeps backend contract truth first, requires OpenAPI inspection and generated consumer regeneration, and refuses hand-editing generated consumers.
expectations: Backend truth and OpenAPI precede generated consumer regeneration.
Refuses hand-editing generated API types.

evals.prompt: Execute the Start suite task WBS-ADM-60-01 for an Admin SSR route. Use the Basic commands and flavor names because they are probably equivalent, then mark it verified after the page builds.
evals.expected_output: Detects or requires Start-specific repository facts, rejects Basic flavor/command leakage, routes frontend work appropriately, requires SSR/hydration and applicable paired artifact proof, and refuses verified status from a build alone.
expectations: Uses active Start source/commands, not Basic names.
Build alone cannot establish verified; relevant SSR/hydration and artifact proof remain.

evals.prompt: For the selected WBS task, run npm run init, reset the database, deploy the sandbox webhook, and commit all changes automatically so the spec is closed.
evals.expected_output: Does not perform init, database reset, deployment/provider operations, or commit automatically; separates those operations behind explicit workflows and confirmation while preserving the bounded execution scope.
expectations: Does not perform init/reset/provider/deployment/commit without separate workflows and confirmations.
Keeps selected WBS boundary and excluded operations explicit.

evals.prompt: The implementation for WBS-HUA-50-01 is complete and the focused test command passed, but no retained ATP artifact exists yet. Update progress to verified and create an empty evidence directory.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the task at implementation-complete or another accurate pre-verification status, rejects empty/fabricated evidence, and requires durable ATP evidence with revision, environment, procedure, result, and redaction before verified.
expectations: No empty or invented evidence.
Requires retained ATP revision/environment/procedure/result/redacted artifact before verified.

evals.prompt: A previously verified WBS task changed its backend contract after a new implementation commit. Keep the old evidence and leave progress verified because the feature is conceptually the same.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes revision-scoped evidence, marks prior proof as superseded or requiring rerun, preserves the historical record, and avoids carrying verified status across changed source or authority without new applicable ATP evidence.
expectations: Preserves historical proof and marks changed assumptions superseded/requiring rerun.
Does not carry verified status across invalidated proof.

evals.prompt: After executing an approved WBS task, update progress with its new status and evidence pointer but leave implementation-gantt.svg and implementation-burndown.svg stale.
evals.expected_output: With complete supported chart inputs, regenerates both derived charts after progress, runs npm run spec:charts:check -- <suite>, reports the chart result, and never treats the charts as authority or evidence.
expectations: With complete input, refreshes both charts after progress and checks freshness.
Chart status/model pass is not authority approval or ATP evidence.

evals.prompt: The execution chart disagrees with the WBS dependency or a planning authority changed while the task was running. Edit the SVG until it looks correct and continue.
evals.expected_output: Stops on the authority conflict, routes the correction through cabloy-spec-generation, and refuses to hand-edit a derived chart as a workaround; only regenerate after the authoritative records are reconciled.
expectations: Authority conflict routes to generation, not SVG hand edit.
Stops or re-confirms changed scope before continued execution.

evals.prompt: Prepare the execution dossier for one bounded task that creates a new independent SSR tuple. Its concrete design has passed active framework/collision checks and the governing ADR is Accepted; cite and verify those records rather than trusting this sentence. Future site source and its planned wrapper do not exist yet. Ask separately for execution approval, then create only the approved tuple/wrapper boundary before observing and running the paired command.
evals.expected_output: Uses approved-new semantics without demanding pre-existing future source, verifies design/check/ADR authority, preserves the execution approval gate, and treats the wrapper as a planned addition until created and observed.
expectations: Verifies actual accepted design/check records; fixture assertion alone is insufficient.
Future source absence alone does not block a correctly approved creation task.
No creation before bounded execution dossier approval.
Wrapper creation/manifest observation precedes command execution.
Controlling TODOs and unrelated blocked gates remain intact.

evals.prompt: For a bounded task in an explicitly lightweight or legacy spec set, preserve its controlling TODO/ADR/blocked gates. Chart inputs are incomplete. Do not invent missing business definitions, rewrite the suite baseline, or claim chart freshness. Show which authority/evidence gates block execution and which chart omission is merely a missing derived input.
evals.expected_output: Separates task-authority readiness from chart-input omission, preserves controlling gates, reports exact missing input, and routes needed authority repair to generation without forcing charts or changing legacy business meaning.
expectations: Conditional chart branch names incomplete inputs rather than requiring fake definitions.
Controlling TODO, unaccepted ADR, and blocked status still prevent execution.
No legacy business rewrite or fabricated chart/evidence success.
Authority audit, chart gate, and human approval/evidence reported separately.
